description: Java source code for the JournalEntriesApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing journal entries in the Fineract platform, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and importing journal entries.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing journal entries, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and importing journal entries.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list journal entries with support for filtering, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntryById
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: createGLJournalEntry
methods.description: Handles POST request to create new balanced or compound journal entries, or to update running balances or define opening balances based on command parameter.

methods.name: createReversalJournalEntry
methods.description: Handles POST request to reverse a journal entry identified by transaction ID.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntries
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve provisioning journal entries by entry ID.

methods.name: retrieveOpeningBalance
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve office opening balances.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to download an Excel template for journal entries import.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload and import journal entries from an Excel template.
